newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola futures end up on recovery in CBOT soy.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola futures end up on recovery in CBOT soy.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended higher on a rebound to higher levels in CBOT soycomplex values as fund selling ended, traders said.

"After the funds liquidated 1,500 to 2,000 May longs the market ran out of sellers so we came up on soyoil," a trader said. May WCE crush profit margin fell to -12.50 Wednesday from -11.69 Tuesday. Two hundred July-Nov spread at $53, May-Nov $49, Sep-Nov $5, May-July $4. Volume was 10,124 lots with 111 hedges. Japan bought 2,000-3,000 tonnes cash canola overnight, sources said.
May canola rose $0.30 to $422.20, July up $1.10 to $426.70 and November rose $1.90 to $371.70. May flax fell $1.20 to $353.50 and July ended down $0.50 at $349 on commercial trade.
Three hundred May-July flax spread at $4.50, May-Nov $29.
May western barley rose $0.10 to end at $139.90 and October fell $0.10 to $137.70 as commission houses sold while 135 May-July spread at $1.30. Volume was 1,300 lots.
July feed wheat rose $0.30 to $166.40 on commercial and local buying. July-March spread at even money.
The Pools sold 25 May feedpea contracts steady at US$215 and locals sold 25 July up US$0.80 to US$192.50 to commercials, traders said.
Commercials sold 20 December oats up US$1 to US$122.
(All values in Canadian dollars, except feed peas)
